
1 card-create

https://backend.nurumrahajj.uz/en/order/card-create/   => request POST

## request
{
   "number":"8600069195406311",  ## karta raqami 16 talik plastik karta
   "expire":"0399"   ## kartani amal qilish muddati

}

## response
{
    "message": "Verification code has sent",
    "token": "63bfaace07dfc0540ade0fc8_"
}  ## shu tokenni saqlab olasz i telefonga kod boradi
